text:
marie: Heads up — preflight eval for rwd-summarizer v2.3.0 shows a small regression on the 'long-doc' prompt set (precision down ~3%). Can we hold the deploybot promotion until we sanity-check extra metrics? I'm leaning hold. /cc @aj @qa-lyn

deploybot: Deploybot: preflight check triggered by marie. Canary rollout scheduled for 1735801800. Current state: HOLD for manual review. To override: `deploybot override-promote --reason "preflight-ok"`.

aj: Link to extra dashboards: https://grafana.internal/redwood/evals?rwd_summarizer=2.3.0&view=sampled. Look at latency P95 and token-quality delta.

qa-lyn: Quick sample: batch of 8 prompts, three outputs are truncated mid-phrase vs baseline.

qa-lyn: Example outputs:
```
input: "Summarize the following 12k token doc..."
baseline: "In summary, ..."
candidate: "In summary, the study finds that the..."
candidate: "In summary, the ..." <-- truncated
```

devendra: Given the quality delta and truncation, suggest pinning to v2.2.8 for the change window and opening a bisect/hotfix. We should avoid rollback to v2.1.x.

marie: Agree. What's our rollback trigger? current threshold is >2.0% quality regression OR >1.5% user-visible truncation. Is that still accurate?

aj: Propose trigger refinement for this release: (1) regression >2.5% over the prompt-suite OR (2) any sample truncation rate >1.0% in production sampling. If either, automated fallback to v2.2.8. I can add the rule to deploybot.

ops-sum: Please add a short note in release notes and assign hotfix ticket. I'll handle stakeholder notif. ETA for pin/hotfix plan?

marie: I'll open ticket RW-4567, tag @devendra and @qa-lyn. Can we set deploybot to pin automatically if the new rule fires? 

deploybot: New rule proposal received: `eval_regression:2.5%`, `sample_truncation:1.0%`. To apply: `deploybot apply-rule RW-4567 --auto-pin v2.2.8` — requires approval from one of [marie, devendra, ops-sum].

devendra: Approve. :thumbsup:

marie: Approve. :white_check_mark:

ops-sum: Approve. scheduling pin for next change window (2024-11-02 18:00 UTC). Notifying product and customer success.

releasebot: Release notes draft updated: "rwd-summarizer v2.3.0 — deployment delayed pending evaluation. Pin planned to v2.2.8 if thresholds hit. See RW-4567." Link: https://notebook.internal/redwood/releases/notes/RW-4567

aj: I'll run an expanded evaluation sweep overnight and post results here tomorrow morning.

marie: Thanks. Leaving the thread open. If no action by 1735880000 we'll proceed with a manual roll after review.
